description: This file defines the 'VideoResolution' class within the 'device' namespace, which extends 'DSConstant' and encapsulates video resolution settings such as pixel resolution, aspect ratio, stereoscopic mode, frame rate, and scan type. It contains static methods for retrieving instances and member methods for accessing associated resolution attributes. The file relies on several external headers and appears to be part of a larger device settings module.
